O.content: The blue line begins at the 1880 tick near the 1,000 y-axis tick and ends at the 1891 tick below the 3,000 tick but visibly higher on the page than its 1880 endpoint.
The horizontal axis is inscribed "Year" and shows ticks from 1880 through 1891; the vertical axis is inscribed "Number of Tourists" and shows 0, 500, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 2,500, and 3,000.

B.text: If the horizontal axis labeled "Year" orders the plotted line from 1880 to 1891 and the vertical axis labeled "Number of Tourists" uses the visible numeric ticks with larger values higher on the page, then a line endpoint higher at 1891 than at 1880 indicates a higher new-tourist count at the end than at the start. If routing is based on overall endpoint growth, that interpretation supports growth planning.
B.conditions: Assumes the single blue line represents Town Z new tourists for the labeled years and that endpoint change, rather than the title or only the latest year-to-year movement, is the routing criterion.
